scientific_question: Within species, are flower-colour discontinuities stronger than expected from geographic distance plus additive thermal-regime and atmospheric-energy/dryness turnover when both environmental contrasts are simultaneously high on the same fixed edge?

rationale_lineage.precolour_positive_signature: colour discontinuity tracks drought/thermal/edaphic turnover beyond geographic distance

external_predictors.per_axis_standardization: same global finite-cell z-score used by the expanded CHELSA parent-block runner
external_predictors.edge_block_score: for each block, square root of the mean squared endpoint difference across its four globally standardized axes
external_predictors.source_byte_rule: all eight raster bytes must match the already frozen SHA256 values before colour alignment

edge_and_colour_geometry.colour_edge_score: same four-group JSD edge score followed by the same within-outer/species midrank transform used in RGFCA
edge_and_colour_geometry.joint_environment_coverage: retain only edge occurrences whose two endpoints are complete for all eight fixed CHELSA axes; missing environment is never recoded to zero

primary_interaction_test.within_species_transform: for retained edge occurrences, average-tie rank each of colour score Y, great-circle distance G, thermal turnover T, and atmospheric-energy/dryness turnover A across all retained occurrences for that species, then center and scale each ranked variable to mean 0 and population SD 1
primary_interaction_test.model: z(rank(Y)) = beta0 + beta_G*z(rank(G)) + beta_T*z(rank(T)) + beta_A*z(rank(A)) + beta_TxA*[z(rank(T))*z(rank(A))] + error
primary_interaction_test.rank_condition: design matrix [1,G,T,A,T*A] must have full column rank 5; otherwise that species is not evaluable
primary_interaction_test.global_statistic: equal-species arithmetic mean beta_TxA over all evaluable species
primary_interaction_test.positive_direction: beta_TxA > 0 means simultaneous high thermal and atmospheric-energy/dryness turnover predicts stronger colour discontinuity beyond their additive main effects and geographic distance

null_and_decision.null_operation: same within-species complete colour-vector permutations as RGFCA with edge geometry, distance, CHELSA predictors and interaction design fixed
null_and_decision.support_rule: observed global mean beta_TxA > 0 AND p_upper < 0.05
null_and_decision.multiplicity: exactly one frozen exploratory interaction test; no within-family adjustment because no second interaction is allowed

claim_ceiling_if_supported: Exploratory evidence that flower-colour discontinuities are stronger where thermal-regime and atmospheric-energy/dryness turnover coincide beyond additive main effects and geographic distance. This is not confirmatory support for H11, not a rescue of the five-block panel, and not evidence of causal adaptation or anthocyanin stress benefit.
claim_if_not_supported: Close the frozen thermal-by-dryness interaction line; do not try alternative interaction transforms or thresholds on these outcomes.
